definitions.explanation: The distance from the surface to the bottom, or the quality of being profound.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どのくらい→どのくらい：09584_donokurai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: To check the depth of the wound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the depth of his knowledge.

notes:
{深|ふか}さ is a noun meaning 'depth', derived from the adjective ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep) plus the nominalizing suffix さ.

FORMS:
⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (adjective: deep) + さ (suffix) → {深|ふか}さ (noun: depth)

This pattern (i-adjective stem + さ) creates abstract nouns:
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ → ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ (height)
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ → ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧ (length)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ → ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧ (width, spaciousness)
- ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ → ⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧ (weight)

LITERAL USES (physical depth):
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of water
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of a wound
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of snow

FIGURATIVE USES (abstract depth):
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of love
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of knowledge
- ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of sorrow
- ⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ: depth of flavor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {深|ふか}さ: depth (vertical distance down, or profundity)
- ⟦{奥行|おくゆ}き→奥行き：10569_okuyuki⟧: depth (front-to-back distance)
